name: CyberThreat-Eval
description: An expert-annotated benchmark assessing large language models on practical cybersecurity threat intelligence tasks across triage, deep search, and threat intelligence drafting stages. It uses analyst-centric metrics measuring factual accuracy, content quality, and operational costs.
reputation: A recent expert-annotated cybersecurity benchmark that is new and not yet widely established, but is notable for covering practical threat-intelligence workflows rather than toy classification tasks.
notes: Collected from real-world CTI workflow of a leading company; addresses limitations of existing benchmarks by covering full analyst workflow and using human expert knowledge.
